description: The two pie charts compare the distribution of categories between "AttentionInfluence" and "FineWeb-Edu Classifier". The "AttentionInfluence" chart has 16 slices, with the largest slices being "Education" (25%, light green), "History & Society" (23%, orange), and "Health & Medicine" (22%, blue), while the smallest slice is "Policy" (1%, blue); other notable slices include "Tech & Engineer" (12%, red), "Animal & Plant" (13%, red), "Science & technology education" (10%, green), and "Society & culture" (10%, orange). The "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" chart has 15 slices, with the largest slice being "Education" (38%, light green), followed by "Science & technology education" (19%, green), "History & Society" (19%, orange), and "Health & Medicine" (19%, blue); other slices include "Tech & Engineer" (8%, red), "Animal & Plant" (12%, red), and "Teaching & resources" (17%, green). Both charts have labels and numerical values directly on the slices, and the slices are color-coded, with shades of green, blue, red, and orange used throughout; the slices in both charts appear to be ordered by size, with the largest slices first.
